summary: A low-tier melee-attacking giant task assigned only by Vannaka and Krystilia; the wiki says it is rarely done outside Wilderness Slayer because the drops are poor and most spawns are far from a bank. Ice giants have a 100% weakness to fire spells and no special protection is needed. The recommended spot is the Wilderness Slayer Cave, where a cluster of 14 stronger level 67 giants sits in a multicombat, cannonable area below level 20 Wilderness with the cave's improved drop table. Outside the Wilderness the western Asgarnian Ice Dungeon giants are multicombat and cannonable with no other monsters to interrupt.
styleNotes: 100% elemental weakness to fire spells (Ice giant infobox 'elementalweaknesstype = Fire, elementalweaknesspercent = 100'); not poisonous, not immune to cannon or poison; the Wilderness Slayer Cave variant is a stronger level 67.
usefulItems: Dwarf multicannon (Wilderness Slayer Cave or Asgarnian Ice Dungeon)
Fire spells
Ranged weapon for safespotting
Pickaxe (50 Mining) for the White Wolf Mountain top / Ice Queen's Lair giants
One-click teleport if in the Wilderness
alternatives: Eldric the Ice King (Royal Titans; only when assigned by Vannaka)

summary: A 52 Slayer task known for hard clue scrolls. Jellies attack with magic-based melee that bypasses physical armour, so either pray Protect from Melee to negate all damage or wear high magic-defence armour like dragonhide. The wiki does not recommend killing regular jellies in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (poor drops, far from a bank); instead do warped jellies in the multicombat Catacombs of Kourend, ideally bursting or barraging them, or the Wilderness Slayer Cave for Krystilia tasks where nine jellies sit in a cannonable multicombat area below level 30 Wilderness.
styleNotes: Magical melee attackers with unusually high Defence for their level; Protect from Melee negates all damage; regular jellies have a 35% earth weakness and warped jellies 30% earth, while chilled jellies have a 50% fire weakness (infobox elementalweaknesstype/percent); not poisonous, not immune to cannon (Vitreous Chilled Jelly alone is immunecannon = Yes).
usefulItems: Protect from Melee (prayer potions or super restores)
Ice Burst or Ice Barrage runes (rune pouch)
Slayer ring or Dramen/Lunar staff for fairy ring AJR
Kourend Castle Teleport runes or Xeric's talisman (Xeric's Heart)
Cheap darts or knives to tag monsters
Gem bag
Empty slot for brimstone keys on Konar tasks
superior: Vitreous Jelly (Vitreous Warped Jelly / Vitreous Chilled Jelly for the variants)

summary: A common task from every master except Mortimer and Krystilia. All kalphites except the Queen use melee, and soldiers and guardians poison (starting at 4 and 6) through protection prayers, so Protect from Melee plus poison immunity negates everything. The wiki says tasks should be done in the task-only Kalphite Cave east of Shantay Pass, whose open multicombat chambers are cannonable and need no rope: cannon workers for a fast task or soldiers for XP, and avoid guardians. If Konar forces the Kalphite Lair, cannon the soldiers on the upper level; the Queen is not worth it without the Elite Desert Diary shortcut.
styleNotes: All kalphite variants (worker, soldier, guardian and Queen) have a 40% elemental weakness to fire; the task page says kalphites are weak to crush attacks, that keris weapons deal 33% more damage to them, and that the keris partisan of breaching adds a further 33% accuracy; soldiers (4) and guardians (6) poison through protection prayers, workers cannot poison.
usefulItems: Dwarf multicannon
Protect from Melee
Poison immunity (antidote++/anti-venom)
Keris partisan or keris partisan of breaching
Rope(s) for the Kalphite Lair unless Hard Desert Diary is done
Shantay pass or fairy ring BIQ

summary: A 37 Slayer task assigned only by Mazchna, done on the Killerwatt plane reached through Professor Oddenstein's portal at the top of Draynor Manor after Ernest the Chicken. Insulated boots are required: without them both their melee and ranged attacks hit up to 15 instead of 6 and 8, though the bonus does not go through the correct protection prayer. They appear as passive orbs but transform and rush you as soon as they are clicked, and switch between melee and ranged by distance, so Ranged or Magic (air spells) from a safespot locks them into ranged attacks.
styleNotes: Negative ranged defence and a 60% weakness to air spells; attack with stab/crush melee and magical ranged; not aggressive until clicked; not immune to cannon but no cannon can be placed on the plane.
usefulItems: Protect from Missiles or Melee as appropriate
Air spells
Halberd if meleeing to keep them at range

wikiTaskPage: King Black Dragon (boss page; no 'Slayer task/King Black Dragon' page exists)
summary: The King Black Dragon is a three-headed dragon in a lair reached only by pulling a lever in the western entrance of the Lava Maze Dungeon in the deep Wilderness; the lair itself is a multicombat, non-Wilderness area that can be instanced for 50,000 coins, and he also counts for a black dragon task unless Krystilia assigned it.
styleNotes: Uses stab melee and dragonfire ('four different breath attacks; normal dragonfire alongside three special dragonfire attacks'); an anti-dragon shield with an antifire potion 'will prevent his regular dragonfire damage, and reduce his special dragonfire damage to 10'; poisonous (Yes (8)); 50% elemental weakness to water; not immune to cannon but 'Most bosses, such as the King Black Dragon, destroy cannons set up near them'.
usefulItems: Antifire potion
Burning amulet (Lava Maze teleport)
Items you are willing to lose on the Wilderness walk
